title: GPT-6 Astra targets computer use and complex professional workflows
friendlyTitle: OpenAI’s Astra model can work across websites and desktop apps
summary: OpenAI has made GPT-6 Astra available in ChatGPT Work, Codex and its API, emphasizing computer use, browsing, coding and document-heavy professional work. API pricing starts at $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens, while enterprise controls can restrict websites, desktop applications, uploads and downloads.
friendlySummary: GPT-6 Astra is now available for work, coding and API use. OpenAI says it can handle complex tasks in familiar software, and companies can limit which websites, apps and files it may use.
whyItMatters: A model that can operate existing applications may reduce integration work, but it also expands the consequences of a mistaken action. Businesses should evaluate complete tasks on their own data, start with narrow application access and keep confirmation policies on until measured reliability supports broader autonomy.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This may save integration time, but mistakes can affect real systems. Begin with limited access, require approval for important actions and test full tasks before trusting it with more.
